{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Remove duplicate patient entries by keeping the highest sample_seq
data_sorted = data.sort_values(by='sample_seq', ascending=False)
data_unique = data_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Calculate the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
total_patients = len(data_unique)
severe_patients = data_unique['severity'].value_counts().get('severe', 0)
fraction_severe = severe_patients / total_patients

fraction_severe"}
